Place your sister / Didu memory photos here!

Suggested filenames:
- photo1.jpg
- photo2.jpg
- photo3.jpg
- photo4.jpg
- photo5.jpg
- photo6.jpg

Supported formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP.
Captions, titles, and dates can be customized in `src/config.ts`.
If photos are not yet placed here, beautiful scrapbook memory cards will be displayed automatically without broken image links!
